messages:
deploy-bot: rollout started for model 'embedder-x' tag=model:prod:20270401+build42 -> initiating canary on 5 hosts

deploy-bot: smoke tests failing on canary: tokenizer decode errors observed, 502s for embed endpoint, sample error: "tokenizer: unknown id 50213"

eva_oncall: seeing the same in logs, oncall 👀 — rate of 502s ~18% on canaries, prod traffic routed to canary via feature flag 'use_embedder_x'. Rolling this up to incident. Paging oncall.

incident-bot: @eva_oncall acknowledged pager (P1) — escalation to eng-oncall and releng.

samir: jumping in. quick check: models manifest shows weights digest for model:prod:20270401 -> digest dW123, tokenizer artifact listed as tokenizer:20270315 -> digest tQ999. those don't match the expected paired bundle. looks like tokenizer from older build.

jordana: @samir can you confirm whether this is a packaging issue or tagging? If packaging, we should kill rollout and rollback.

samir: initial look points to a tag resolution bug in the rel-eng pipeline — the release job published two artifacts and the manifest pointed at tokenizer tag that belonged to a previous release. weights and tokenizer vocab sizes mismatch (weights expect vocab_size=50304, tokenizer artifact vocab_size=50240) — that explains unknown id errors.

alyssa: immediate mitigation: flip feature flag to route away from new canary. doing now.

jordana: flipping flag 'use_embedder_x' -> false (command):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://flags.internal.redwood/v1/flags/use_embedder_x \
  -d '{"value": false, "actor": "jordana"}'
```

jordana: flag set to false. traffic back to stable. monitoring for error rate drop. :white_check_mark:

mike: customer impact? do we have reports?

ana-cs: Support: three customers reported degraded search relevancy and intermittent API 502s since 12:04 UTC. All are on Hosted API region us-west-2. Escalated to SEs, outreach in progress.

eva_oncall: starting controlled rollback to previous stable model: model:prod:stable-20270320. ETA ~3m. Command: `rcli model rollback --service=embedder --to=stable-20270320 --force`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by eva_oncall at 12:12:08 UTC. Streaming logs:
```
[12:12:09] pulling model stable-20270320 shards...
[12:12:15] loading weights to pool g-embed-1..4
[12:12:29] updating router to point at stable-20270320
[12:12:34] running healthchecks (smoke tests) => OK
```
deploy-bot: rollback complete, healthchecks green, error rate back to baseline (~0.3%). Canary instances terminated.

samir: confirmed weights-vocab mismatch is the root cause. releng pipeline used tag semantics that selected tokenizer by timestamp rather than bundle id when the tokenizer publish step retried and created a duplicate tag. manifest resolution logic picked the wrong artifact.

alyssa: creating incident page and assigning releng (samir, jordana) + infra (mike) for postmortem. Temporary guard: adding preflight that verifies tokenizer/weights checksum pair before rolling any model; also adding a canary preflight to validate vocab_size parity.

jordana: filing bug: RELENG-8272 — manifest tag resolution picks latest by timestamp causing cross-release artifact mixing. attaching logs and manifest snapshots.

mike: customer outreach: please coordinate with Ana-cs for messages, acknowledge impact and that a rollback occurred; offering 1:1 support if customers still seeing issues.

ana-cs: acknowledged. drafting template outbound: short apology, note rollback completed, asking for any affected request ids.

samir: quick mitigation patch going out to releng pipeline: enforce paired artifact lookup by bundle_id and fail publish if tokenizer and weights bundle_ids diverge. will also add a unit test. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/releng/pull/593

eva_oncall: handing off for follow-up to @jude (next shift) — will link incident doc and checklist.

jude: on it. taking lead on postmortem and follow-ups. priority: (1) revert tag resolution logic, (2) add preflight checks, (3) run inventory to find any other releases that may have mixed artifacts.

incident-bot: severity updated -> sev2 (reduced) — pager closed. incident timeline recorded.

eva_oncall: quick notes for postmortem: cause = tag resolution mismatch allowed tokenizer from previous build to be pulled; impact = ~18% errors on canary, 3 customers reported issues; mitigation = feature flag flip + rollback to stable; long-term fix = releng pipeline enforcement + preflight checks.

alyssa: thanks team — will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 0900 UTC. assigning owners in the doc. :clap:
